evidence_items.explanation: The interviews and survey support the convergence component. The accompanying discussion describes applications designed to permit switching, but does not establish that all providers lack durable advantages.

Existing cloud relationships, security considerations and procurement processes influenced model selection. These are possible advantages beyond model quality, although this research does not establish their durability.
